title: TextServer bug in 4.7 rc2
body: EDIT: Apparently processing the CallQueue while this is running causing TextServerAdvanced::rasterize_msdf() to be restarted. This is a regression from: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/120072 ### Tested versions **Tested versions** Reproducible in 4.7 rc2 Not reproducible in 4.7 rc1 and earlier ### System information Godot v4.7.rc2 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9186) - AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 63.15 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description **Tested versions** Reproducible in 4.7 rc2 Not reproducible in 4.7 rc1 and earlier **Issue description** ``` E 0:00:14:045 _shaped_text_substr: Condition "sd->end < p_start + p_length" is true. Returning: RID() modules/text_server_adv/text_server_adv.cpp:5545 @ _shaped_text_substr() E 0:00:14:045 _shaped_text_get_ascent: Parameter "sd" is null. modules/text_server_adv/text_server_adv.cpp:7803 @ _shaped_text_get_ascent() E 0:00:14:045 _shaped_text_get_descent: Parameter "sd" is null. modules/text_server_adv/text_server_adv.cpp:7814 @ _shaped_text_get_descent() E 0:00:14:045 _shaped_text_get_size: Parameter "sd" is null. modules/text_server_adv/text_server_adv.cpp:7788 @ _shaped_text_get_size() E 0:00:14:045 _shaped_text_is_ready: Parameter "sd" is null. modules/text_server_adv/text_server_adv.cpp:7678 @ _shaped_text_is_ready() E 0:00:14:065 _shaped_text_substr: Condition "p_start < 0 || p_length < 0" is true. Returning: RID() modules/text_server_adv/text_server_adv.cpp:5543 @ _shaped_text_substr() ``` I have had a project which has been in development for a long time. This project has been migrated from 4.7 rc1, where this issue is completely nonexistent, to rc2, where this bug suddenly started happening. I had nonchip investigate this with me and it seems like 'it was told to shorten a string, to a longer length than it was' was the verdict and this is a potential regression. The issue is nonexistent if I run game levels through Play Scene. If I start a project through the main menu ingame now, using the menu: i.e. ``` func _on_test_level_1_pressed() -> void: load_level(Level.ABOVEWORLD) func load_level(level_index: Level) -> void: var level_to_load: LevelLoad = levels[level_index] EnemyManager.clear_all_enemies() LevelThemingManager.set_global_level_theme(level_to_load.theme) get_tree().change_scene_to_file.call_deferred(level_to_load.scene) ``` ```class_name LevelLoad extends Resource @export_file("*.tscn") var scene: String @export var theme: StringName ``` I get these errors. Seems like potentially a text clean up edge case transitioning from the title menu to a level? Can't figure it out. ### Steps to reproduce Load any of my game levels using the load_level function written above. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) I tried to make an MRP but I can't replicate the issue. It might require something I am missing, and I still cannot pinpoint what is going on.
